controller.automation_transition_order: After this GitHub contract gate is green, update and enable the authoritative task with the exact controller commit and source hashes; verify its saved prompt, timezone schedule and enabled state; only then pause the superseded watchdog. A green GitHub gate alone never authorises pausing the watchdog.
